_about: Honest, tested internationalization matrix for GreenPath. It replaces the blanket 'any language / 100+ languages' marketing claim with per-language capability status. No accuracy numbers are claimed: each field reports whether a capability is wired and which dependency governs it. 'device-dependent' means it relies on a browser/OS API whose availability we cannot guarantee on every device.

notes.ocr: Document scanning uses tesseract.js in the browser. A language is 'supported' when Tesseract ships official trained data for it (the named traineddata code). OCR quality still depends on image quality.
notes.read_aloud: Read-aloud uses the browser Web Speech API (SpeechSynthesis). Voice availability varies by operating system and browser, so it is reported as 'device-dependent' rather than guaranteed; common languages usually have a voice, rarer ones may not.
notes.translation: Translation routes through the AI proxy, so it works for languages the configured model supports and requires a valid OPENAI_API_KEY (or demo mode).
notes.handoff_detection: The deterministic attorney-handoff safety stop has EXPLICIT high-risk patterns only for English, Spanish, and Simplified Chinese (see handoff.py). Other languages fall back to English-trigger matching, so a non-English high-risk phrase may not be caught deterministically — this is a known, documented limitation, not a hidden one.
